prompt: Rendered in the style of oil painting, a bustling wedding reception unfolds with rich textures and warm tones. On the left side of the canvas stands a tall man in a navy suit holding a crystal flute. Beside him sits a woman in a silver dress resting her chin on her hand. In the center foreground, a golden retriever lies patiently next to a spilled glass of red wine. A bride in a white lace gown dances with a groom wearing a black tuxedo near the middle of the room. To their right, an elderly woman in a floral blouse claps her hands rhythmically. Behind them, a young boy in a blue shirt points excitedly at a tiered cake on a wooden table. A waiter in a white apron carries a tray of hors d'oeuvres past a guest in a green velvet jacket. The guest in the green velvet jacket reaches out to take a canapé from the tray. Near the back wall, a musician in a suspenders plays a violin while looking at his sheet music. A cellist in a dark vest sits on a stool beside the violinist, bowing deeply into her instrument. Two children, one in a pink dress and another in yellow shorts, chase each other around a potted fern. The child in the pink dress grabs the leaf of the fern as she runs. An older man in a grey beard watches the children with a smile, leaning against a pillar. Next to the pillar stands a woman in a purple scarf adjusting her earrings. A photographer in a black vest kneels on the floor to capture the scene. He looks through his camera lens at the dancing couple. A cat with orange fur sleeps atop a stack of gifts in the corner. A large chandelier hangs above the entire scene, casting soft glows. There is no digital clock visible on any wall. There is no smartphone held by any guest. There is no exit sign illuminated in the background.
